log.msg: COLD WALK, 108 pages x 1280 and 3440 = 216 loads, following every in-realm link. ONE console error at each width and it is the same known one: the declared-child probe 404 on readme/page.js. Zero sideways document scroll at either width. 102 of 108 titles distinct; the six without a title are the raw .js/.json file links, which is what they are. No visible zero-size box: the only flags my checker raised were the hidden nav slots inside the 49 live cells on /cross/, correct by design at 1280 and absent at 3440.

ALL FIVE OF MY VISIT-7 ITEMS ARE FIXED, RE-MEASURED. (1) The nest field keeps what you type: I clicked into it, typed dashboard with keystrokes, NEVER pressed Enter and never left the field, then named the page and pressed Make this a page - and public/imagine/paging/made/eighth-visit/page.json read nest dashboard. A line under the field said what the value meant while I typed it. (2) It reads back: arriving at ?nest=dashboard the field holds dashboard, the chip is pressed and the dashboard is running in the box. (3) A page I made can be unmade, through BOTH doors - the made page's own drawer (Delete Eighth visit, then Yes - delete Eighth visit and its file) and Make's row x (the row turns into Delete Row delete test? with Delete it and Cancel). (4) On /templates/navigation/ the row whose label reads imagine/paging/words.js now goes to /imagine/paging/words.js. (5) Zero raw .md links anywhere in the realm - every prose link opens the rendered doc page.

THE NINE-STEP USE TEST, ALL NINE. What I wanted, written into my own note BEFORE I asked for it: a page with a rail down the left, at reading width, in the dark, holding that note in its box, with a whole other page running inside it - and then thrown away. (1) PICK - four dropdowns and the address field took it; choosing A page or file... in CONTENT opened a full-width address line, 934px, with Draw it and Copy. (2) SEND - ?navigation=rail&content=%2Fframework%2Fai%2F2026-09-05%2Fpaging-audit-8%2Fnewcomer-note.md&room=reading&page-colour=dark. (3) COLD - a fresh browser gave the same seven classes, all eight bar values AND the address field holding my file, with my words in the box. (4) SAVE + (5) NEST + (8) SAVE THE NEST, in one press: I typed dashboard into the nest field with keystrokes, never pressed Enter, never left the field, named the page and pressed Make this a page - made/eighth-visit/page.json read nest dashboard, and the parent's children gained eighth-visit a beat later. (6) CONTENT I WROTE - the box holds a file that did not exist when this realm was written. (7) EDIT FROM THE PAGE'S OWN BAR - on /make/eighth-visit/ I set ROOM to Full; the file read room full within the second, the url stayed bare and the nest stayed. Its x turned the row IN PLACE into Delete Row delete test? with a red Delete it and a Cancel - no modal, no navigation. Delete it took the row, the directory and the line under the list from 6 pages under made/ to 5. Zero console errors through both doors.

INFINITE POTENTIAL, BOTH HALVES, RE-TESTED WITH THINGS THE REALM NEVER HEARD OF. ?content=/imagine/paging/make/notes/ draws a page I made inside the box. And the nest field takes an arbitrary ADDRESS, not just the twelve chips: I typed /imagine/paging/make/notes/ without pressing Enter and the file box already read nest /imagine/paging/make/notes/; Enter put it in the url and the whole Notes page ran inside the box.

assign.now: scoring the six words, writing the owner's paragraph and the list

log.msg: SIX WORDS, eighth visit (delta from 5/5/5/4/5/5). simple 5 -> 5. powerful 5 -> 5. organized 5 -> 5. intuitive 4 -> 5. easy to browse 5 -> 5. infinite potential 5 -> 5. FIRST STRAIGHT FIVES IN EIGHT VISITS.

WHY INTUITIVE MOVED TO 5. The single thing holding it at 4 was a save that said it kept a nest it had thrown away. It cannot now: I typed the nest with keystrokes, never pressed Enter, never left the field, and the file on disk had it. Better than that, the file box gained the nest line WHILE I TYPED, and a sentence under the field told me what the value meant before I committed to it - so the confirmation arrives before the press, not after. And the thing a newcomer could not do at all last visit - unmake a page - now has two doors, each of which turns into a question in place and says exactly what goes: The directory, its page.json and every page under it go - and the page above it stops naming it, in the same write.

MY EXIT CONDITION, ANSWERED: ALL FIVE ARE TRUE, for the first time. (1) Every label delivers within one screen - both of last visit's liars are gone and I found no new one. (2) I got the page I came for with dropdowns only, all nine steps, ending in unmaking it. (3) One set of names from the rail to the bar to the address bar: I set three skin words and the url read ?content-colour=tint&page-colour=dark&type-size=display - the labels, verbatim. (4) Nothing broken at 1280 or 3440: 216 cold loads, one known console error per width, zero sideways scroll. (5) Infinite potential in both halves: a file I wrote an hour ago sits in the box, and a page I made an hour ago runs inside another page.

WHAT A NEWCOMER STILL CANNOT DO. Add a child under the page they are looking at from its own bar - the made page's drawer offers Copy the link, the words, Put it inside, Copy the file, Copy the code and Delete, but no Add a page under this one; you go to Make's row and press + page. And type prose into the box without going to Build. Both were on the seventh list too, neither is new, and neither stopped me getting the page I came for. There is no undo after a delete either - the confirm is the only guard - but the confirm names the page and says what goes, and the row asks in place without a modal.

FOR THE OWNER, in one paragraph. Paging is a page you build from dropdowns instead of code. Six words - navigation, content, room, arrangement, colour, type - rebuild the page under the bar as you change them, and every choice lands in the address, so the page you like is a link you can send. Point it at your own file, drop another whole page inside it, press Make this a page and it is real, on disk. The same drawer deletes it. (75 words.)

MY INSTRUMENT FOUND ITSELF SEVEN TIMES BEFORE IT FOUND ANYTHING REAL. (a) The zero-size check flagged the hidden nav slots inside /cross/'s 49 live cells - correct by design, and gone at 3440. (b) I read made/page.json a beat too early and reported that a saved page never reached its parent's children; the two writes are sequential and the child was there on the next read. (c) text=More clicked a link in the readme and walked me to /mechanisms/expand/, and I nearly reported the drawer as broken. (d) On a columns page there are two of every selector and one is hidden - .paging-more resolved to the ancestor column's copy and timed out for 30s. (e) I grabbed a .grip at x3441 and reported the drawer as unresizable; that grip is the DEV BAR's, parked past the right edge, and the drawer's own is at 3137 - dragging it took the drawer 304 -> 797 and the file box 280 -> 768 with nothing clipped. (f) My delete confirm selector anchored ^Delete it$ and never matched, because the button's text is delete_forever + Delete it. (g) My above-the-fold sweep said /navigation/'s first demo was 2971px down; the two demo boxes are at 250 and are not .paging-stage. Every one of the seven would have been a false finding.

COVERAGE AND HYGIENE. 108 pages x 1280 and 3440 = 216 cold loads following every in-realm link; the nine-step use test end to end; all five visit-7 items re-measured; both delete doors driven to the disk; the drawer opened and read in full on the realm root, on Build and on a page I made; four ways to set a nest tried (chip, field with Enter, field WITHOUT Enter, ?nest= in the url) and the file read after each; an arbitrary page address used as both content and nest; the bar labels compared against the url keys and the file keys; every link on eight prose pages checked for a raw .md (zero remain). Private server 8098 (node pid 44176), killed by pid. THREE test pages were made and all three deleted BY THE FEATURE UNDER TEST; made/ is byte-identical to baseline by md5; git status shows only task dirs and the ai logs.

FIX LIST, ranked. COSMETIC ONLY - none of the four loses work, blocks a step, or says something false; all four are wording and defaults, and I got the page I came for without any of them being fixed. 1 The file the drawer hands you speaks a different dialect from the bar above it - the drawer, on any page, under THIS PAGE, AS A FILE - I set CONTENT COLOUR Tint and PAGE COLOUR Dark, the url said ?content-colour=tint&page-colour=dark (the labels, verbatim) and the file said "surface": "tint", "background": "dark"; the decision to keep the old disk keys is deliberate and recorded (doc/decisions.md, One name per thing), but Make invites me to open those files in an editor and nothing on that screen tells me surface IS content colour - one line under the file box - S. 2 A nest you type is named by its directory, not its title - the drawer's nest field, on any page - type /imagine/paging/make/notes/ and the line under it reads "notes goes inside this page's box" while the page is called Notes and all twelve chips use titles; the fetched page knows its own title - use it - S. 3 Your page's file is shown through the narrowest slot in the realm - the drawer, at every width - the file and code boxes are 280px at 1280 and 275px at 3440 while the JSON needs 430, so on a 3440 screen with 3000px spare I read my own page sideways; it does scroll, Copy the file works, and dragging the drawer's edge takes it to 797 with the box at 768 on 768 and nothing clipped (measured) - but the edge is 12 unmarked pixels and nothing suggests it - widen the drawer when the window is wide, or mark the grip - S. 4 One row of a two-row table names a file it does not open - /imagine/paging/templates/navigation/, the USES table - the MECHANISMS row now goes to words.js (the seventh visit's item 4, fixed), and the row above it, whose description reads imagine/paging/paging.js, still goes to /imagine/paging/mechanisms/; one of the two is wrong and they sit one line apart - S.

assign.outcome:
**Eighth visit: 5 / 5 / 5 / 5 / 5 / 5 — straight fives, the first in eight visits.** All five of my seventh-visit items are fixed and re-measured, the use test grew to nine steps and all nine worked, and for the first time all five of my exit conditions are true.

**Cosmetic only.** Four items left, and not one of them loses work, blocks a step, or says something false.

![My note, in the dark, at reading width, with a rail down the left and a whole other page running inside it — on a page that did not exist an hour ago](shots/my-page-nested-1280.png)

**The nine-step use test, all nine.** I wrote what I wanted into my own note **before** I asked for it: *a page with a rail down the left, at reading width, in the dark, holding this note in its box, with a whole other page running inside it — and then thrown away.* Pick · send · open cold · save · nest · content I wrote · edit from the page's own bar · save the nest · **unmake it**.

**`intuitive` moved 4 → 5, and here is exactly why.** The one thing holding it was a save that said it kept a nest it had thrown away. It cannot now: I typed `dashboard` with keystrokes, **never pressed Enter, never left the field**, named the page and pressed *Make this a page* — and the file on disk read `"nest": "dashboard"`. Better than the fix asked for: the file box gains the nest line **while you type**, and a sentence under the field says what the value means **before** you commit — the confirmation arrives before the press, not after.

![Delete, from the page's own drawer — it names the page, and says exactly what goes](shots/delete-from-its-own-drawer-1280.png)

**A page you make can be unmade, through both doors.** The made page's own drawer offers *Delete Eighth visit* → *Yes — delete Eighth visit and its file*. **[Make](/imagine/paging/make/)**'s row `×` turns the row **in place** into *Delete Row delete test?* with a red **Delete it** and a **Cancel** — no modal, no navigation. Both took the directory, the parent's `children` entry and the count under the list together; the url answers *404 — nothing matches*.

**All five seventh-visit items, re-measured.** The nest field keeps what you type **and** reads back (`?nest=dashboard` fills the field, presses the chip and runs the page). Delete exists in both places. The row labelled `words.js` goes to `words.js`. **Zero raw `.md` links remain anywhere in the realm.**

**216 cold loads** — 108 pages × 1280 and 3440, following every in-realm link — **one console error at each width**, the known `readme/page.js` probe 404, and zero sideways scroll.

**One set of names, proved.** I set three skin words and the address read `?content-colour=tint&page-colour=dark&type-size=display` — the bar's labels, verbatim.

**For you, in one paragraph.** Paging is a page you build from dropdowns instead of code. Six words — navigation, content, room, arrangement, colour, type — rebuild the page under the bar as you change them, and every choice lands in the address, so the page you like is a link you can send. Point it at your own file, drop another whole page inside it, press *Make this a page* and it is real, on disk. The same drawer deletes it.

**Left deliberately:** two things a newcomer still cannot do — add a child from the page's own bar, and type prose into the box outside **[Build](/imagine/paging/build/)**. Both were on the seventh list; neither is new; neither stopped me.

**My instrument found itself seven times before it found anything real** — hidden nav slots read as zero-size boxes, a parent file read one beat too early, a `text=More` that walked me to another page, a columns page's hidden twin of every selector, the **dev bar's** grip mistaken for the drawer's (the drawer *is* resizable: 304 → 797px, the file box 280 → 768 with nothing clipped), an anchored selector that missed a button with an icon in its text, and a fold check that put a demo 2971px down when it sits at 250. Every one would have been a false finding.

**Hygiene:** private server 8098, killed by pid; three test pages made and **all three deleted by the feature under test**; `made/` byte-identical to baseline by md5; `git status` shows only task dirs and the ai logs.
